tcp.title: Connect a Meizu ESP32 gateway
tcp.description: Enter the IP address and TCP port of the Meizu gateway.

tcp_reconfigure.title: Configure gateway OTA
tcp_reconfigure.description: Enter the OTA key read through USB with ota-key. Leave it blank to keep the saved key.

esphome.title: Connect through ESPHome
esphome.description: Add the ESPHome node first. Enter its action name without esphome., the component api_service name, and the puck BLE MAC. No IR is sent by this form.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the gateway. Check its address, firmware and network.
error.cannot_authenticate: Could not connect or authenticate. Check the gateway address and OTA key.
error.cannot_connect_esphome: No matching ESPHome status response. Check the device, action, api_service and puck MAC.

init.title: Learn an infrared command
init.description: Point the original remote at the top centre of the puck, less than 1 cm away. Submit the names, then wait for the prompt to press the button. Saving does not transmit infrared.

data.replace: Replace an existing command with the same name

progress.connecting: Connecting to the puck to learn “{command}”. Please wait.
progress.listening: Press “{command}” now. Keep the remote aligned within 1 cm. About {remaining} seconds remain.
progress.receiving: Signal received for “{command}”. Stop pressing while the data is received and checked.

error.invalid_name: Enter a device name and command name of 1–80 characters.
error.already_saved: This command exists. Enable replacement to learn it again.

abort.learning_unsupported: Update the gateway to firmware 0.6.0 or later to learn commands.
abort.gateway_unavailable: Connect the gateway and bind a puck first.
abort.learning_busy: Another command is being learned. Finish that session first.
